official_measurement_examples.name: Using Marine Plans publication
official_measurement_examples.fact: MMO published its consolidated Using Marine Plans guidance on 1 April 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Eleven marine plan areas
official_measurement_examples.fact: MMO guidance states there are 11 marine plan areas in England with marine-plan policies in place.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 58(1) decision rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: MMO guidance explains authorisation and enforcement decisions affecting the marine area are made in accordance with the appropriate marine policy documents under section 58(1), subject to the statutory framework.

official_measurement_examples.name: Section 58(3) distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: MMO's 2026 hypothetical examples distinguish other public-authority functions under section 58(3), which must have regard to appropriate marine policy documents.

official_measurement_examples.name: Explore Marine Plans scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Explore Marine Plans displays geographic, licensing, environmental-designation and regional marine-policy information for England.

official_measurement_examples.name: Retained plans
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2025 three-year reporting guidance states North East, North West, South East, South West and South Marine Plans were retained and not amended at that time.

official_measurement_examples.name: East plan replacement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The East Marine Plans fourth three-year report published 14 July 2026 says replacement remains in progress with adoption currently planned towards the end of 2027.

official_measurement_examples.name: MPPA application role
official_measurement_examples.fact: MMO marine-licensing guidance says applicants need to complete a Marine Plan Policy Assessment as part of the marine licence application process.
